diagnosis.rootCause: PostgreSQL transaction lock contention in the database dependency is blocking queries, causing shop payment lookups to time out and the web service health check to fail.

plan.reason: The diagnosed cause is PostgreSQL transaction-lock contention, but the PostgreSQL container is not among the listed targets and no enabled action can resolve its blocking transactions. Restarting shop-web would not fix the database contention.
plan.instructions: Have the PostgreSQL operator identify and resolve the transaction(s) blocking ShareLock waits (for example, by completing or rolling back the blocking transaction where appropriate). The diagnosis does not identify the blocker or PostgreSQL container, so I cannot safely name a specific session or command; no listed action can perform this database-side fix.
